# Discussion Categories

Create these categories in the repository's **Settings → Discussions** page:

- General Questions
- Windows Automation
- OCR & Parsing
- Vendor Registry
- Roadmap & Planning
- Showcase

GitHub stores discussion categories in repository settings; the templates in this folder provide matching prompts but do not create the categories automatically.# Discussion Categories
